messages.body: I am currently managing the Payments API legacy architecture and Payments Settlement Service while we spec out v2.

Team announcement: Effective today 2026-09-28, Asha Patel (@asha) is taking over as the official technical and operational owner of Payments API v2 and Payments Settlement Service. David Kim (@david) has transitioned to Core Systems. Please direct all release readiness and service reviews to Asha.
Confirmed! Excited to lead Payments API v2. First priority is hardening settlement locks and resolving upstream gateway race conditions.
@asha Can you check ticket PAY-104? We have test alerts showing double-settlement risk during Stripe latency spikes. Is this an unresolved blocker for our Q4 release?

Yes, PAY-104 is an active release risk. ADR-0042 solved client idempotency with headers, but banking webhook retries arrive asynchronously before initial transactions finish committing. We need a dedicated distributed lock barrier on payment intent IDs. Without that worker-level mutex, releasing Payments v2 is unsafe.
